system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have a single [One-Handed] weapon equipped to a [Hand Slot]. Your [Attack Power] becomes [Weapon's (Attack Power) x2]. During the first round of a scene, reduce the [Hate] cost of your [Weapon Attacks] by -1 (minimum 0).

(SR2): Instead of during the first round of a scene, you always apply the [Hate] cost reduction.

A battle style that combines offense and defense, using one-handed weapons to attack and the other to use healing magic.
